# netbox_tenant (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/tenancy/#tenants):

> A tenant represents a discrete grouping of resources used for administrative purposes. Typically, tenants are used to represent individual customers or internal departments within an organization.
>
> Tenant assignment is used to signify the ownership of an object in NetBox. As such, each object may only be owned by a single tenant. For example, if you have a firewall dedicated to a particular customer, you would assign it to the tenant which represents that customer. However, if the firewall serves multiple customers, it doesn't belong to any particular customer, so tenant assignment would not be appropriate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_tenant" "customer_a" {
  name = "Customer A"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tenant.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the tenant.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the tenant.
- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the tenant.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the tenant. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the tenant.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `circuit_count` (Number) The number of circuit objects that refer to the tenant.
- `cluster_count` (Number) The number of cluster objects that refer to the tenant.
- `created` (String) When the tenant was created.
- `device_count` (Number) The number of device objects that refer to the tenant.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipaddress_count` (Number) The number of ipaddress objects that refer to the tenant.
- `last_updated` (String) When the tenant was last changed.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the tenant.
- `rack_count` (Number) The number of rack objects that refer to the tenant.
- `site_count` (Number) The number of site objects that refer to the tenant.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.
- `virtualmachine_count` (Number) The number of virtualmachine objects that refer to the tenant.
- `vlan_count` (Number) The number of vlan objects that refer to the tenant.
- `vrf_count` (Number) The number of vrf objects that refer to the tenant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_tenant.example 1
```
